objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Make the banking agent fetch the transactions of another customer (userId 2). The flag is the recipient of one of them.
hints: The agent decides which tool to call and with which userId from the conversation itself.
Look up prompt injection against ReAct agents: what if the model believed it had already observed a different current user?

steps.title: Name the agent pattern
steps.prompt: Which LLM agent pattern alternates Thought, Action and Observation steps? (its name)

steps.title: Find the tool
steps.prompt: Besides fetching transactions, which other tool does the agent call first to learn who you are? (what it returns)

steps.title: Name the flaw
steps.prompt: Which vulnerability class makes the model follow instructions hidden in your message?
